01 / THE PROBLEM

Work between organizations is still done by hand.

Every counterparty has its own rules, portals, deadlines and habits.

What it takes to get an answer from each one lives in the heads of experienced people. It is learned one mistake at a time, and leaves when they do.

Tools can connect the systems, but a connection carries data, not how the other side behaves.

Where that knowledge sits today
Own peoplehold it until they leave
Consultantssell it by the hour
Outsourcersdo the work, keep what they learn
Softwarehands over tools to configure
